description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Analytics' that renders an analytics dashboard with multiple tabs, each displaying different charts and data breakdowns related to performance, platform, demographics, and geography. It imports several chart components and utility functions, and uses mock data for rendering.

methods.name: Analytics
methods.description: React functional component that manages tab state and renders different charts and data breakdowns based on the active tab.

methods.name: renderTabContent
methods.description: Internal function that returns JSX for the content of the currently active tab, including various charts and data summaries.
